hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/hunting-island/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 102 sites'; '102 of the standard sites offer 20/30 & 50 amp electrical service'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 102 standard sites with electric and water in two campgrounds at the north end of the park, plus 25 walk-in tent sites and a primitive group area. Some sites take RVs up to 40 ft, others up to 28 ft.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/hunting-island/camping ('Some sites accommodate RVs up to 40 ft.; others up to 28 ft.'; 'Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 102 sites'; 'Designated Tent Sites: 25 sites'), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/hunting-island/camping ('restrooms with hot showers'; Laundry Facilities: Yes; Dump Station: Yes) + https://southcarolinaparks.com/hunting-island (Campground Store Hours 9 a.m. - 5 p.m. daily), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Most campsite reservations require at least a 2-night stay'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. One reservation may be no longer than 14 nights. Same-day reservations must be made directly with the park (843-838-2011).

booking.source: https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/hunting-island/campsites ('Most campsite reservations require at least a 2-night stay'; 'no longer than 14 nights'; reservation policies: 'up to 13 months in advance', 'less than one day in advance of check-in must be made directly through the park') + https://southcarolinaparks.com/hunting-island/camping, read 2026-10-20; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry, with the AWH phone waiver). Added 50-amp electric + water at 102 sites, max RV 40 ft (some 28 ft), 14-night reservation cap, showers/laundry/dump/camp store. Fees left as read 2026-10-12 (calendar prices not in static HTML). Not stated: sewer, season dates, pull-throughs. Park admission $8/adult is listed but not whether campers pay it, so not written.
